description.label: Description
description.value: Once per game session, you may make a Challenging (+0)@UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.epSHxgJWtT1S0yMY]{Trade (Cook)} Test. This Action requires at least several minutes. At the GM’s discretion, you might gain a bonus to this Test for acquiring certain ingredients to truly enhance your meal. If you succeed, you and your allies gain a +10 bonus to Willpower Tests to resist the effects of @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.Ib2YQYChktDFN93y]{Fear}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.I0yPc4PH5erWJLmu]{Intimidate} and @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.meMkLEwdJIDLxM0B]{Terror} for SL hours or until the end of the session. If the cooking Test succeeds by 6 SL or more, the first time each ally uses a Fortune Point before the end of the effect, that character rolls 1d10. On a result of 6+, that character still gains the benefit of using the Fortune Point, but the Fortune Point does not count as having been expended.
